description.value: Reckless The Bike Store is a full-service bicycle retailer on Davie Street in Vancouver's Yaletown area, part of the Reckless Bike Stores chain. The shop covers the full spectrum from sales and accessories to mechanical service, with a dedicated Rad Power Bikes eBike service program. Touring cyclists will find rental bikes, pannier bags, and professional mechanical staff under one roof.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 16m; stands (7 spaces) at 95m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched but the captured content is overwhelmingly Shopify navigation menus and a global currency selector, limiting access to body text. Enough navigation structure is present to confirm an active service department (dedicated 'Rad Bike Service' and 'Bikes and eBikes' service subpages), a rentals section (Performance Road Rentals, City Rentals & eBike Rentals), and pannier bags listed explicitly as an accessory category. Phone number and street address were not independently corroborated in the captured text.
concerns: Website capture was dominated by Shopify navigation chrome and a global currency selector dropdown; detailed page body content was not rendered, preventing corroboration of phone number and street address.
